# Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

> The FAO is the UN agency leading global efforts to combat hunger, improve food security, and promote sustainable agriculture and rural development.

FAO.org serves as the primary digital hub for the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, providing access to organizational information, statistical data, country profiles, and news on global food security, sustainable farming, water management, and gender equality in agriculture. The site emphasizes crisis response, international campaigns, and partnerships to address food insecurity and environmental sustainability.

## Key Topics

- Food Security
- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Agrifood Systems
- Water Management
- Rural Development
- Gender Equality & Women Farmers
- Agricultural Development
- Forest Conservation
- Crisis Response
- International Day of Forests
- World Water Day
- International Year of the Woman Farmer 2026
- FAOSTAT
- Country Profiles
- Partnerships

## Core Organization

- [Home](https://www.fao.org/home/en): FAO homepage featuring food security and sustainable farming initiatives
- [Overview](http://www.fao.org/about/en): FAO organizational overview, mission, and membership information
- [Themes](http://www.fao.org/themes/en): FAO thematic areas including OCOP, Hand in Hand, and strategic framework
- [Partnerships](http://www.fao.org/partnerships/en): FAO partnerships with civil society, private sector, and academia

## Data & Reference

- [Statistics (FAOSTAT)](http://www.fao.org/statistics/en): FAOSTAT data portal for food, agriculture, and SDG indicator statistics
- [Country Profiles](http://www.fao.org/countryprofiles/en): FAO country profiles database covering member nations globally
- [Transparency Portal](https://www.fao.org/transparency/en): FAO transparency portal tracking budget, programs, and resource allocation

## Global Campaigns & Initiatives

- [International Year of the Woman Farmer 2026](https://www.fao.org/woman-farmer-2026/en): International Year of the Woman Farmer 2026 initiative spotlighting women in agrifood systems
- [International Day of Forests](https://www.fao.org/international-day-of-forests/en): International Day of Forests campaign promoting forest conservation and tree planting
- [World Water Day](https://www.fao.org/world-water-day/en): World Water Day 2026 campaign on water security, gender equality, and women farmers
- [FAO celebrates 2026 International Day of Forests and World Water Day](https://www.fao.org/newsroom/detail/fao-celebrates-2026-international-day-of-forests-and-world-water-day/en): FAO news on forest-water linkages and sustainable resource management

## News & Crisis Response

- [In Focus - FAO Response to Global Food Security Challenges](https://www.fao.org/in-focus/en): FAO crisis response analysis on food security, markets, and emergency situations
- [FAO Report: Agriculture Remains a Lifeline for Rural Families in War-Affected Ukraine](https://www.fao.org/newsroom/detail/fao-report--agriculture-remains-a-lifeline-for-rural-families-in-war-affected-ukraine/en): FAO report on agriculture's role in rural resilience during Ukraine conflict
- [Where There Is Water There's a Way](https://www.fao.org/newsroom/story/where-there-is-water-theres-a-way/en): FAO story on water resilience and irrigation infrastructure in Angola

## Cultural & Heritage Partnerships

- [FAO's Food and Agriculture Museum Links with WOW Agrifood Museum in Siena](https://www.fao.org/newsroom/detail/fao-s-food-and-agriculture-museum-and-network-links-with-new-wow-agrifood-museum-in-siena/en): FAO partnership with WOW Agrifood Museum for cultural heritage engagement
